# puff

Unmodified puff.c and puff.h from zlib v1.3.1, contrib/puff, by Mark Adler.
https://github.com/madler/zlib/tree/v1.3.1/contrib/puff

The permissive zlib license is reproduced in puff.c. Used only for bounded raw DEFLATE decoding of TES plugin records; the caller validates the zlib header, size and Adler-32 checksum.
